blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero on Friday announced the schedule for the remaining proceedings in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. The announcement came as the court temporarily suspends proceedings to make way for deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget, which begin on Monday, November 23. […]...
